title: Justly Sweet Portuguese Macaroni Pasta
description: A sweet and light Portuguese dish featuring macaroni, this recipe is a nostalgic treat that is macrobiotic-friendly. It combines the simplicity of pasta with the sweetness of raisins and the comfort of olive oil.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the raisins and pine nuts and cook for 2 minutes, until the raisins are plump and the pine nuts are fragrant.
Drain the cooked macaroni and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the onion and raisin mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the macaroni to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Let it cool before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
